title: Casks
description: Portable, shulker-like storage for the early game.
body:
# Casks

**Casks** are simple, shulker-like early-game portable storage blocks that can hold up to 3 stacks of items. Craftable with 3 matching Wooden Slabs, Flower Pots, and String, Casks can be obtained quickly in any Survival world, and minimize the hassle involved in exploring for the perfect home by streamlining inventory management.

![Six crafting grids showcasing six different Cask variants, crafted with 3 Slabs along the bottom, 3 Flower Pots through the middle, and 2 String on either side of the top.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/caa365dba842f9b69607a80f5028e860a144147f.png)

## Extra Features

Casks can also be placed above campfires to siphon suitable items from their inventory onto the campfire.

Casks interact with Hoppers and Comparators as you would expect.

Casks cannot be stored in Shulkers, nor can they store Shulkers. They can be placed in any other container as you would expect.
